name: Incident Loom
short_description: A replayable security-log investigation workspace: append-only synthetic batches normalized and de-duplicated, correlation rules, incidents whose every claim links to source events, hypotheses with alternatives, and gaps that lower confidence instead of hiding.
capabilities: Four log formats (JSON lines, nested JSON, syslog-like text, CSV) normalized to one event schema with source line or pointer
Deduplication of exact and re-delivered copies, out-of-order flags, declared clock-skew correction, quarantine with reasons
Eight correlation rules with documented thresholds; incidents with evidence-linked timelines
Causal links only with a shared session, request, process or parent id; time order is worded as sequence
Hypotheses with supporting, contradicting and missing evidence, and alternative explanations
Declared and silent log gaps recorded and used to lower confidence
Held-out detector precision and recall on labelled synthetic scenarios; checkpointed restart with byte-identical replay
GitHub-native run ledger, outcome loop and memory curation
data_limitations: All batches are synthetic logs of a fictional organisation
Held-out metrics use labels written by the same author as the detectors; they show the evaluation works, not real-world accuracy
No response actions; nothing touches a real system
The site shows a snapshot of the state branch, not live data
